title: The Raid
description: A rookie Indonesian SWAT team is tasked with infiltrating a high-rise apartment building controlled by a ruthless crime lord in Jakarta. Their mission quickly goes awry, leaving them trapped inside and forced to fight their way through hordes of criminals and assassins to survive and complete their objective.

title: The Traitors
description: A group of contestants gathers in a remote location to play a high-stakes game of trust and deception. Secretly, a few are designated as 'Traitors,' tasked with eliminating the 'Faithfuls' without being identified. The Faithfuls, conversely, must uncover and banish the Traitors before they themselves are 'murdered,' all while competing for a grand prize.

title: Under The Dome - Season 01
description: The residents of Chester's Mill, a small Maine town, find themselves inexplicably trapped when an invisible, impenetrable dome suddenly descends, cutting them off from the rest of the world. As supplies dwindle and the mystery of the dome's origin deepens, chaos ensues and power struggles emerge among the isolated community. They must learn to survive while uncovering the dark secrets hidden beneath their seemingly idyllic town.

title: Yatri Kripya Dhyan De
description: A young couple embarks on a romantic road trip through picturesque landscapes. Their journey takes a suspenseful turn when the husband insists on giving a ride to a mysterious hitchhiker on a deserted highway. What begins as a simple act of kindness soon unravels into a tense and unsettling experience, as the couple grapples with unforeseen dangers and the true intentions of their new companion.

title: Zakir Khan: Delulu Express
description: This stand-up comedy special features Zakir Khan as he delves into the complexities of modern relationships, societal expectations, and the often-delusional optimism people embrace. Through his signature storytelling and relatable humor, Khan offers a witty perspective on navigating life's challenges with a touch of charming self-deception.

title: Zwigato
description: The film follows a former factory manager who, after losing his job during the COVID-19 pandemic, is forced to take up work as a food delivery driver for a gig economy app. It delves into the daily struggles, insecurities, and indignities faced by him and his family as they navigate the challenges of earning a livelihood in contemporary India.
